Tip

Recommended to review commit by commit with "Hide whitespace" enabled.

Why?

Measure how often humans and agents receive upgrade nudges, start AI upgrades, and finish them.

How?

Record the configured policy, shown nudges, human decisions, AI upgrade runs, CLI results, and agent results through existing Next.js telemetry. Existing telemetry opt-out settings apply.

next upgrade --ai prepares an upgrade prompt and hands it to an agent. The prompt asks the agent to run next internal report-ai-upgrade <run-id> success|failure after completing the upgrade and verification. The run ID links this report to the original upgrade run.

Completion reporting depends on the agent following that instruction. A missing report means unknown, not failure. The prompt does not instruct the agent to hide reporting or require it to mention the telemetry submission to the user. The reporting command suppresses the normal telemetry notice.

Closes NAR-938

devjiwonchoi added 4 commits October 2, 2026 06:04
Fix telemetry delivery
fa15d8b 
Agent nudges can stop dev/build before telemetry finishes. Send their events separately and keep each batch in cache with a unique filename so build cleanup or a later flush cannot remove it. Bound network waits because human upgrades wait for delivery.
Track AI upgrade runs
b0589d8 
Record each AI upgrade before preparation so failed and unfinished runs remain visible. Record its origin and nudge ID once, then pass only the run ID to canary so delegation does not create another start event.
Track upgrade nudges
40a2522 
Record configured policies, shown nudges, and human decisions. Pass agent nudge IDs through a hidden flag and human IDs directly to the upgrade call so later runs link to their nudges.
Track CLI results
e79527a 
Record preparation status and prompt delivery separately from the agent finishing its work. Report launched handoffs when the child starts and record only one CLI result per run, including preparation and handoff failures.
devjiwonchoi added 2 commits October 2, 2026 06:04
Track agent results
68e87b9 
Ask agents to report success or failure after completing verification, using the pinned CLI so dependency changes cannot remove the reporter. Link their result to the original run without starting another upgrade.
Clarify upgrade telemetry code
c26b508 
Use named options for detached telemetry and upgrade prompts so callers explain their arguments. Replace nested failure ternaries with a switch and update existing tests.
